records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Granite Studio!
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero customer replies to two Wrenfield emails (email:c994cc0b, email:ed465f29), no tickets, and no project, invite, or milestone. No signal of self-driven activity, so unaided activation within the remaining 8 days is unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Granite Studio's first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Following up on my welcome note last week. Since Granite Studio is still getting settled, the easiest starting point is one real project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready for the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
